name: Juanita Martin
office: City of Santa Fe Springs, Member of the City Council

items.text: Juanita Martin is a member of the Santa Fe Springs City Council, first elected in 2009, and has served as the city's mayor three times. In September 2026, the council selected her as mayor pro tem.
